sections.body: The asserting party ordinarily bears the initial burden on essential facts, subject to admissions and statutory presumptions. Electronic records should be authenticated and presented under the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023.

enhancement.detailedExplanation:
India Code rule: Section 23 sets the statutory tests of lawful consideration and object; section 24 addresses partial unlawfulness; section 25 states the general no-consideration rule and its exceptions.

Definition: The legality and consideration provisions determine whether the bargain’s object and consideration are enforceable and whether a promise without consideration falls within an exception.

Ingredients:
1. Identify the object and consideration.
2. Test each against every section 23 ground.
3. Where unlawfulness is partial, apply section 24.
4. If consideration is absent, test the section 25 exceptions exactly.
examples: A promises to pay B for a service previously rendered voluntarily to A; the promise can fall within section 25(2) if its statutory conditions are satisfied.
problemApplication: Apply sections 23–25: identify the exact statutory trigger, test the relevant ingredients or authority rules, address any exception, and conclude.
